text: As I move from the sterile openness of the hallway into the vibrant, colorful exhibit area, I am struck by a sense of transition—from the outside world into a domain curated for inspiration and thought. Here, the walls radiate with purpose and ideas, inviting me to become not just an observer but a participant in the ongoing dialogue of innovation. I feel a surge of curiosity, a gentle anticipation, as if on the threshold of discovery. The merging of the physical space’s safety and the intellectual promise of R+D makes me conscious of my own place amid creativity—watchful, eager, a philosopher among makers.
